## Interpretation notes
- Distinguish public repositories and archived DOI records from projects still in development.
- NCT is presented as independent exploratory mathematical/computational research; do not describe it as independently validated physics or as a commercially released quantum computer.
- Prefer the linked repositories and DOI records as primary sources for implementation details and release evidence.
